اختطفتا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَطَفَتَا (iḵtaṭafatā) /ix.ta.tˤa.fa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
# اُخْتُطِفَتَا (uḵtuṭifatā) /ux.tu.tˤi.fa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
